content.text:
Thinking aloud as I scroll:

- Big heading "מדריך" says "כל סוג של חיסכון והשקעה". OK, that's what I came for, so I'll stay.
- "שני חלקים בכל חיסכון": the "where it's held" and "what it's invested in" thing. I read the first line and moved on.
- "מאיפה להתחיל" is the bit I actually want. It says "שכירים שהמעסיק מפקיד להם: קרן השתלמות". That's me, and I already have one. "הבסיס של כל חוסך שכיר: קרן חדשה מקיפה" is the pension, which HR already did. "כסף שצריך להישאר זמין: קרן כספית".
- Then a wall of boxes. "כסף שוטף וקצר": עו"ש, פיקדון, I know those. "מק"מ" means nothing to me, so I skipped it.
- "חיסכון עם הטבת מס": קרן השתלמות again. "קופת גמל להשקעה" sounds like something for old people. Skipped.
- "פרישה" and "לילדים" aren't for me, so I scrolled past.
- "לבחירה עצמית": "חשבון ניירות ערך … שבו קונים, מוכרים ומחזיקים מניות". OK, so that's how you buy the S&P.
- "במה הכסף מושקע": I found "מדד S&P 500", "הכסף מושקע בדולרים דרך קרן שעוקבת אחריו". That's the thing my friends talk about.
- Lots of other indexes, MSCI and stuff. They all look the same to me, I didn't read them.
- The last screen is just a black strip, so the page ends there.

**What I'd tell a friend:**
I sort of worked out the menu, but I didn't decide anything. The S&P 500 seems to go through a "חשבון ניירות ערך" at the bank. My קרן השתלמות is already the first thing on the page's "where to start" list. And a "קרן כספית" is the thing for money I might need soon. I'm fairly sure about that much. What helped was the short "מאיפה להתחיל" list near the top. After that it's about 25 boxes that all look alike. There isn't a single number on the page, no fees in shekels, nothing saying "with 30,000 do this first". So I'd close it and look up S&P on my bank's app. I didn't open any of the boxes, and none of them said "fees" or "how much".

**Words I didn't get:** מק"מ (and it's there twice), קופת גמל להשקעה, "אג"ח ממשלתית צמודה" / "לא צמודה", "חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו", MSCI AC World and MSCI World (what's the difference?), "מסלול כללי".

**Where I got bored:** around the "פרישה" and "לילדים" boxes. If I'd kept going in the "במה הכסף מושקע" grid I'd have left there, because it's just a list of indexes with nothing to choose between them.

input.answer: I didn't decide anything. From the page, the ones worth looking into are the קרן השתלמות I already have, a קרן כספית for money I might need soon, and a חשבון ניירות ערך so I can buy an S&P 500 fund. The page doesn't say what any of them costs or what to do first with 30,000.
